status: Fixed in source — explicit release-order is required and validated; frozen runner publication remains pending
area: Broker release order is decided by argument position while the stated intent is unparsed free text
finding: team broker resolve derives releaseOrder, currentAllowedTaskId and blockedTaskIds from which task id occupies --task versus --conflict. The --decision-reason value, which is where an operator states the intended ordering, is copied into the artifact verbatim and never parsed or checked against the order the broker produced. A resolution whose reason says the primary task must go second therefore ships an artifact saying it goes first, with no diagnostic, because the two are not compared. The operator-visible consequence is that the artifact reads as agreement with the stated intent while encoding its opposite, and the task named in the reason as the one that should proceed is the one recorded as blocked.
expectedBehavior: Ordering intent must be structured input, not prose. Expose explicit fields such as priorityTaskId and successorTaskId (or an ordered task list) so the caller states the order in a form the broker evaluates. If a free-text reason is retained for human context, the broker must either ignore it entirely for ordering or detect an intent/order mismatch and fail closed naming both readings; it must not silently accept a reason that contradicts the order it emits. No governed ordering decision may depend on which flag a task id happens to occupy.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-15, ATM-GOV-0395 requesting a serialized successor turn behind ATM-GOV-0370 on the shared path packages/cli/src/commands/framework-development/framework-temp-publication-capability.ts. The command was run with --task ATM-GOV-0395 --conflict ATM-GOV-0370 and --decision-reason "Authorized serialized handoff: ATM-GOV-0370 owns the completed publication-authority source snapshot; ATM-GOV-0395 requires the same consumer seam ... 0395 begins only after the broker grants the successor write turn." The artifact written to .atm/runtime/broker-conflict-resolutions/BCR-qnfiig.json records decisionClass serial-release, releaseOrder [ATM-GOV-0395, ATM-GOV-0370], currentAllowedTaskId ATM-GOV-0395 and blockedTaskIds [ATM-GOV-0370], carrying the quoted reason unchanged alongside them. The reason states 0395 goes second; the artifact grants 0395 the current turn and blocks 0370. Ticket ticket-e41ed7ca10d6b4e9 was created in state ready on that basis. No warning or mismatch code appeared in the output. Because ATM-GOV-0370 reached done independently, the inversion did not block a live publication lane in this instance; that outcome was circumstantial and does not bound the defect.
followUp: Source repair: team broker resolve now requires --release-order, validates that it contains every --task and --conflict participant exactly once, and generated recovery commands include the selected order. decision-reason remains human context only. 2026-09-02 tests/cli/broker-release-order-contract.test.ts proves missing or incomplete order fails closed and an explicit reversed order grants the intended first task; claim-broker-resolution.spec.ts proves generated claim recovery remains executable. Publish a frozen runner before treating this as repaired for frozen CLI consumers.
